raw_response: DESCRIPTION: The plot illustrates the relationship between coverage and the number of completions (k) for four different models: Llama-3B, Llama-3B + FT, Llama-1B, and Llama-1B + FT. The x-axis, labeled "Number of completions (k)," is plotted on a logarithmic scale ranging from 2⁰ to 2⁸, with tick marks at each power of two. The y-axis, labeled "Coverage," is linear and ranges from 0.4 to 0.9. Each model is represented by a distinct line: Llama-3B is shown with a solid blue line and circular markers; Llama-3B + FT is represented by a solid green line with triangular markers; Llama-1B is depicted with a dashed light blue line and triangular markers; and Llama-1B + FT is shown with a dashed light purple line and circular markers. All lines show an increasing trend in coverage as the number of completions increases. At k = 2⁰, Llama-3B starts at approximately 0.44 coverage, Llama-3B + FT at 0.45, Llama-1B at 0.31, and Llama-1B + FT at 0.32. By k = 2⁸, all lines approach a coverage of approximately 0.88, with Llama-3B and Llama-3B + FT reaching slightly higher values than the Llama-1B variants.
